## Work Experience & Major Accomplishments

### Famcare — Founding Engineer & Tech Lead (April 2026 - Present)
FamCare is an in-home care marketplace in India (babysitting, elder care) booked by the hour from an app.
- Architected and delivered the platform from zero to production: one FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend (a modular monolith of about 100 domain packages and 1,400+ API routes) serving four clients (a Flutter customer app, a React + Capacitor caregiver app, a Next.js admin dashboard, and a public live-tracking page).
- Built a voice agent (LiveKit, speech-to-text, LLM extractor) that drafts a child's care profile from a three-minute conversation; nothing is saved until a parent confirms it.
- Wrote the shared caregiver-eligibility module and a suite of 270 YAML scenarios run against a real Postgres database, so every screen agrees on who can take a booking.
- Designed price drops for idle caregiver hours and evening flash sales (stored, signed sale records with push notifications and an in-app countdown strip).
- Imported hand-built AWS production into Terraform with zero drift, set up staging on a shared load balancer, Shorebird over-the-air app patches, in-house feature flags and business-invariant monitoring.
- **Live Links:**
  - [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.famcare.praja&pcampaignid=web_share)
  - [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/famcare-caregiver-in-minutes/id6761720384)

### endorphind — Founding SDE (AI & Systems) (Jan 2026 - Present)
- Engineered SOTA lip-sync and video generation pipelines for a generative video platform.
- Developed custom ComfyUI nodes to automate complex media rendering pipelines.
- Leading platform technical scoping, product roadmaps, and systems engineering.

### shoppin' — Founding ML Engineer (AI/Infra) (Dec 2024 - Nov 2025)
- Led end-to-end visual AI stack, incorporating YOLO, RT-DETR, MaskRCNN, and Diffusion VTON models.
- Developed high-performance Multimodal AI pipelines matching 3-4 crore catalog items and serving CLIP/VLLM systems on AWS SageMaker.
- Engineered automated scraping agents for 200+ partner stores and robust Shopify order automations.
- Architected AWS EKS clusters with GitOps using Terraform and automated CI/CD disaster recovery setups.
- **Live Links:** 
  - [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.shoppin.ios)

## Writing: Building FamCare case studies
Long-form engineering write-ups by Harshit Agarwal, each with the problem, design, rejected alternatives, failures and results.
- [A Voice Agent That Only Drafts](https://www.aharshit123456.space/blog/famcare-voice-agent): an LLM voice interview that only proposes drafts; cost model (~₹9 per interview), model evals, fallbacks and privacy.
- [A Care Marketplace on One Boring Backend](https://www.aharshit123456.space/blog/famcare-system-design): FamCare's system design; booking state machine with physical guards, real time over Redis pub/sub, Terraform import, staging, OTA patches, feature flags, monitoring.
- [Honest Slots, Priced Idle Time](https://www.aharshit123456.space/blog/famcare-slots-and-pricing): one eligibility definition shared by six code paths, 270 YAML scenarios on a real database, price drops and evening flash sales.
